name: X-Men '97
description: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

videos.title: To Me, My X-Men
videos.overview: Cyclops races to find the source of new anti-mutant technology.

videos.title: Mutant Liberation Begins
videos.overview: When Magneto is forced by the UN to stand trial, a group of anti-mutant rioters test his resolve.

videos.title: Fire Made Flesh
videos.overview: The team is propelled into a tragic confrontation with an immortal mad scientist.

videos.title: Motendo / Lifedeath (1)
videos.overview: Jubilee must relive the X-Men's greatest adventures when she's transported into a 16-bit video game.

videos.title: Remember It
videos.overview: Team members hit Genosha as UN honorees while a press event risks exposing the team's dirty laundry.

videos.title: Lifedeath (2)
videos.overview: Storm is forced to face her worst fears in order to free herself.

videos.title: Bright Eyes
videos.overview: The X-Men finds Sentinel inventor Bolivar Trask, realizing they've been played by a mastermind.

videos.title: Tolerance Is Extinction (1)
videos.overview: The X-Men must unite to face a new threat.

videos.title: Tolerance Is Extinction (2)
videos.overview: The X-Men work to settle the score before it is too late.

videos.title: Tolerance Is Extinction (3)
videos.overview: The X-Men's dream is put to the test as mutant-human relations reach a tipping point.

videos.title: Days of Past Future
videos.overview: Forge and Bishop launch an ambitious plan to rescue the X-Men who have been scattered through time.

videos.title: A Force to Be Reckoned With
videos.overview: After E-Day, a covert paramilitary force rises to try to fill the void left by the X-Men.

videos.title: Rise of Apocalypse (1)
videos.overview: The plan to rescue the team from Ancient Egypt is turned upside-down by an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Rise of Apocalypse (2)
videos.overview: An alliance between the X-Men and En Sabah Nur starts to crack when Rama-Tut seeks ultimate power.

videos.title: Weapon X, Lies, and DVDs
videos.overview: Wolverine, Morph, and a motley crew of old rivals face off against Weapon X's latest experiment.

videos.title: Danger.Exe
videos.overview: Former X-Man Polaris returns to Xavier's mansion just as a new threat emerges on campus.

videos.title: Strange Land, Savage Heart
videos.overview: The X-Men travel to the Savage Land and are surprised to find a familiar face.

videos.title: The Dead Man's Hand
videos.overview: The X-Men confront a ghost from their past.

videos.title: Survival of the Fittest
videos.overview: The X-Men are pushed to their limits as their past comes back to haunt them.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 6 wins & 15 nominations total
